text:
Maya: Heads-up — Support ticket #54231 from FinBank. They expect streaming chat that can emit tool/function calls as structured JSON frames mid-stream (their webhook consumes per-frame JSON). Currently when the model triggers a fn_call mid-turn the stream closes the text chunk and they lose the structured call frame.

support-bot: Ticket created: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/54231 — assigned to Maya. :white_check_mark:

Eli: Can you paste the failing payloads + whether they're on Hosted/Dedicated/Private? Also need rough customer tier / ARR impact.

Maya: They're on Dedicated (reserved). FinBank demo blocked. Quick example from logs:
```json
{"type":"message","text":"Can you check acct 123"}
{"type":"tool_call","name":"lookup_account","args":{"acct":"123"}}
{"type":"tool_result","result":{"balance":4200}}
{"type":"message","text":"Thanks"}
```
In our stream they only see the first message and then a final consolidated fn_call after the turn, not the distinct tool_call frame mid-stream. Their webhook expects incremental frames.

Jonah: Engineering note: our streaming contract streams token deltas and supports emitting a single structured fn_call at the end of a turn (we treat fn_call as finalizing). We do have an RFC prototype for "event-level streaming" (RFC-321) but it's not production and changes the framing protocol (clients need to handle event frames vs token frames).

Jonah: Options I see: 
- quick shim (P0 patch for Dedicated customers): buffer and emit a synthetic event wrapper that mirrors a "tool_call" frame as a token stream chunk. Works without protocol change but is brittle and special-cased. Effort: ~1 sprint + QA.
- protocol change (full event streaming): formalize event frames in streaming API (fn_call/tool_result/message as first-class frame). SDK bump + migration. Effort: 3+ sprints and wider rollout.

Priya: FYI Sales — FinBank is in pilot and will likely sign enterprise if this lands before next demo (2 weeks). Revenue signal: medium-high.

Eli: Prioritization question: is this a product bug (we promised structured streaming) or a missing feature? Support says customer assumed structured tool events would stream. So it feels like feature parity hiccup.

Maya: Customer message: "We need the tool call event as it happens so our downstream webhook can trigger a lookup and stream partial results back to user." They can do a short-term workaround (polling) but it's kludgy.

Jonah: Risk notes: changing the framing affects all SDKs and hosted customers — need opt-in rollout and compatibility flags. The shim keeps compatibility but leaks complexity. Also need to think about safety: emitting tool args mid-stream could expose PII earlier; coordinate with privacy/compliance.

Eli: Proposed acceptance criteria for a canary/fast path (P2/P1 depending on biz):
- Dedicated canary: emit synthetic "event" frames that match support webhook expectations for tool_call/tool_result mid-stream (per ticket example).
- End-to-end test showing webhook gets three frames in order (msg, tool_call, tool_result, msg).
- No change in Hosted default behavior unless customer opts in.
- Security review done for PII leakage.

Priya: If we can guarantee a Dedicated canary in 2-3 weeks we can keep FinBank engaged. They need the demo in 10 business days.

Maya: My recommend: create a targeted backlog item and a short spec, do the shim first for Dedicated customers (low blast radius), then plan full protocol work if demand grows.

Eli: Agreed. Triage outcome: create issue RDW-3112 (customer-54231-streaming-fncall-shim). Priority: P2 -> escalate to P1 if FinBank confirms contract-sign timing.

Jonah: I'll pick this up after current sprint wrap. Will post an initial design doc by Mon and estimate exact effort.

Maya: Action items:
- I will create RDW-3112 and link the support ticket + add "support-customer-54231" label.
- Jonah to draft design + ETA (by Mon).
- Security to run quick privacy check (Maya will ping).
- Product to confirm rollout policy (Eli).

Priya: I'll nudge the customer and ask for demo flexibility if needed. :pray:

Maya: Ok moving to backlog. Tagging @Jonah when you post the doc please. :rocket:
